inspection.method: pdftoppm PNG renders, 1400-pixel long side; viewed each page via view_image

summary: Clear substantive verdict and strong scope distinctions, but joined-token prose across limitations, ledgers and references requires repair; source/packet fidelity and URI review remain pending.

page_findings.finding: Abstract opens with an explicit partial-replication verdict, names Schwabe (2016), and describes the source IRT and full-information findings. The distinction between 996 inventory records and completed replication is explicit. Dense 28-row table is readable when enlarged but markedly smaller than body prose. HE27 magnitude is not established although diagnostic direction is retained; HE28 is smaller with same direction. Caption points readers to Appendix A for exact locators, but actual principal source locators appear in Appendix B.

Introduction begins with the partial verdict, 108 contrasts, example estimates, unresolved magnitude and empirical/Bayesian limits. Item-response theory and A/C/E are defined. Section 3 heading extends beyond the normal right text margin. Artifact links have clear visible filenames. Section 2 explains own versus borrowed work without requiring an earlier draft.

Scientific results distinguish source uncertainty, reconstruction uncertainty, path versus variance SE, and failure of posterior convergence. Empirical missing-input blockers and diagnostic-only posterior mean are explicit. Body dense but legible; long decimals slow reading.

Conditional mathematical arguments state assumptions and distinguish population identification, finite likelihood, finite-MLE existence and power. Equations render clearly. Methods paragraph continues normally onto next page.

Methods preserve omitted source Monte Carlo error, non-equivalence, known baseline outcomes and incomplete preregistration. Assumptions are understandable. Runtime prose includes reproducibility details without pretending checks constitute independent studies.

Source ambiguities are scientifically explained rather than merely described as workflow. Printed-formula errors are distinguished from implemented errors and empirical replication. Mathematical typography is legible.

Unresolved targets include specific settling evidence and independent limitations. Beginning of L0 list contains conspicuous joined tokens such as source100-dataset Chapter2 and Chapter5, reducing polish and readability.

L4-L8 contain machine-like strings and joined tokens: H6.precision-grid:36primary, source2%prose/3%plot, C6-3.MAR-bias.A, 11point, inventory:996linked. These require a reader to decode record identifiers and spacing failures. Availability ledger has Full164-page and All12. Its narrow justified columns produce distracting large word gaps.

Availability ledger has joined tokens such as code656..., version1.0, dated2017 and Virginia30K. Scientific compliance ledger uses process statuses followed/departed; accompanying prose makes these requirements rather than success labels, but content is administrative and several sentences are mechanically concatenated (appendices,996linked; R4.5.0,lavaan0.6.19; pletes1000datasets).

Compliance table retains relevant limits but includes Leanformalization and ourMonteCarlo/sourceMCerror concatenation. Next steps are concrete scientific needs. Appendix A is a short map to external 996-record files, not an on-page complete listing; it explicitly calls this inventory coverage. Appendix B explains numerical withheld versus scientific finding.

Appendix B table is legible but narrow fully justified prose columns have large word gaps and many hyphens; half-unit 5 e-05 breaks across lines. HE01 appropriately limits subset claim. Rows HE02-09 explicitly report missing independent targets.

Appendix B continues without repeated column headings on this page, making the column meanings harder to recover. HE17 repeats beta 1a moderation wording even though first-page HE17 is C moderation; this apparent internal discrepancy needs source-stage inspection. Other rows preserve unestablished/blocked targets.

Table has repeated headings and plainly separates precision and power. HE22 retains all 108 signed contrasts and adjusted intervals. The 99.6%HPD and forq strings are visibly joined. Long prose is hard to scan because of narrow justification.

Continuation table again lacks column headers. Reproduction-revision link is labeled separately from navigation and master-publication caveat is explicit. Commands are readable and the saved-report replay is clearly distinguished from fits. Frozen packet SHA breaks across two lines but is legible.
Artifact filenames are visible and readable; replay/build commands fit. References begin normally, with one reference continuing to the next page. No visibly missing citation placeholders.

Dissertation author, full title, institution and 2016 year are provided in references; source URL is readable though wrapped. Citation typography is mostly sound but version4-16, Version4.5.0 and dated15October2015 are joined. Actual link destinations remain uninspected in this phase.

findings.finding: We partly replicated the headline findings of Schwabe (2016) opens with the composite verdict and follows with both source findings and evidence limits.
The opening states partial replication and immediately supplies numerical evidence, unresolved magnitude, and empirical/Bayesian exclusions.

findings.location: Scope limits L4-L8; also pp. 9-10 and 16
findings.finding: The paper is conceptually understandable without earlier drafts, but substantial joined words/numbers and raw record-ID prose undermine finished standalone scientific readability. Page-1 Appendix A locator reference is inaccurate.
All broad components are presented; fidelity to original source requires phase 2.
26 principal claims and 187 component comparisons are asserted, but completeness requires packet comparison.
Extensive visible limitations are intelligible and materially constrain claims; preservation against packet requires phase 2.

findings.location: Scientific compliance ledger opening; also pp. 2-5
findings.finding: The paper explicitly distinguishes inventory records, source reuse, numerical guards, ordinary mathematics, saved-analysis replay and independent scientific evidence. Administrative ledger is lengthy but does not present process completion as replication success.
Schwabe (2016) and original headline findings are stated; bibliographic identity is visible on p.16 but not externally verified.

Magnitudes and directions are separate, unresolved HE27 is not called equal, and descriptive point estimates/not equivalence is explicit. Scientific contrast, tolerance derivation and source precision require evidence-stage verification.
Rows state no-scalar rationale and retain claim verdict separately. Whether each parent is legitimately nonscalar and components complete requires phase 2.

phase2_required: actual URI inventory and target semantics
